slides.texte_overlay:
random healthy hacks
that actually help

get morning sun

step into the sunlight for ten minutes after you wake up. it boosts your serotonin, sets your body clock and helps you fall asleep much more easily at night.

water before coffee

drink a full glass of water before your first coffee. you often wake up dehydrated rather than tired, and that one glass can make a surprising difference.

eat alone sometimes

enjoy a meal on your own without your phone now and then. being truly comfortable in your own company is a small habit that quietly builds real confidence.

care for your mind

you look after your body, so look after your mind too. 5 minutes a day learning something new keeps it calm and curious instead of endlessly scrolling.
slides.texte_sophia:
care for your mind

look after your mind like your body. the Sophia app turns learning something new into one short lesson a day, and 5 minutes keeps my mind calm and curious instead of scrolling.

slides.texte_overlay:
walk after meals

take a short walk after your biggest meal of the day. even ten minutes helps your digestion, steadies your energy and clears your head before you get back to work.
